target.scope: Complete authored Main fixture including excitation; process callback only, no I2S/UI/network.

resource_summary.scope: Historical actual PROFILE values reconciled case→PROFILE→PASS. Reserved arena and context are separate; observed arena highwater is not whole-board peak. New/arena requests are create/prepare counts; render late allocations0.

measured_aggregate.scope: Only original three authored Main workloads; includes excitation, both filters and clock work. No isolated conversion or universal CPU gain.

historical_restoration.scope: Actual saved restoration at the historical run only; later firmware/disconnection/nonRNBO use is outside this record. No current device-state inference.

limits: Only the pinned strict scalar filters-scalar context is available through this option; no full comb/allpass family or31other forms claim.
Signal-controlled duration paths, mixed forms, fixed/v2-storage variants and the integrated drone are not admitted or newly qualified.
Original Double conversion/clamp/return rounding is retained; no Float32 narrowing, ring storage, interpolation, feedback or scheduler change.
Runtime RNE, exclusive opaque state/rings separate from caller planes; no aliases, concurrent prepare/event mutation, external resources or fenv/trap/sticky-flag/NaN-payload equivalence.
Native18case exact-bit/readback/lifecycle coverage is separate from the original3case S3 timing evidence; four new cold/tail workloads have no target timing claim.
Historical target gate is numerical Float32 equality and exact PCM, not IEEE-bit identity or an independent target filter oracle.
Computer-only saved-record admission. No new board execution, USB access, I2S/UI/network timing, live instrument or general deadline guarantee.
